summary: The plan un-hides a pre-built, pre-styled, on-brand portrait of the actual crocheted gift (a 120px gold-ringed circle the page currently hard-codes to display:none) at the first-paint moment where the evidence localizes the claim-gate loss, at zero added latency and fully reversible, without touching the email exchange, the discount code, the printed percentage, or any promise. Every reproducible figure re-ran to the planner's exact numbers, the mechanism raises the felt worth of the SAME email-for-reward trade rather than dismantling it, and the change is visible and honestly labelled unmeasurable-by-design, so it is a sound compounding bet on the biggest, least-worked-by-mechanism leak.

findings.issue: The specific WHY (a 'broken emotional thread') is a bet, not a proven cause - the evidence localizes the loss to first paint but cannot distinguish emotional-disconnect from a discount-ceiling or distrust.
findings.evidence: diagnosis.what_it_cannot_distinguish and cause_verification.against both admit this openly. Session-replay metadata (61% never type) evidences the LOCATION (pre-field-engagement) but not the reason; the durable page_viewed->email_field_engaged->email_entered split only reads ~2026-08-05 and even then separates never-engaged from engaged-declined, not emotional-disconnect from ceiling. This is NOT a contradicted premise (nothing in the evidence disproves the cause), it is an under-determined one, and it is disclosed rather than dressed up. It does not block because the change also corrects a genuine, verified defect (a handmade-gift page that hides the gift) at near-zero cost and is reversible.
findings.required_fix: None required - the assumption is stated plainly, measurable:false is set, and the 08-05 split is queued to inform the next swing. Do not later claim this 'worked' without a SIGNIFICANT tools/significance.mjs result.

findings.issue: Claim-page presentation is flagged as spent ground with rejection-level weight, so an auditor must confirm this is a distinct mechanism and not a disguised reshuffle.
findings.evidence: FUNNEL_CONTEXT.md lines 218-219 elevate claim-page layout/hierarchy reshuffles to standing-rejection weight. This change is distinguishable: PR #8 restructured EXISTING elements (a full layout/hierarchy rebuild -> flat 44.5%->39.0%); this SURFACES a new, already-fetched content element (imagery), which matches the pattern that actually moved the funnel (the 2026-06-16 value-prop hero, imagery+reason, +14pts in-app) rather than PR #8's reshuffle. plan.differs_from_past_attempt makes this argument explicitly and it holds. Neither owner rejection applies (verified in code: no discount code handed over pre-email; no printed-% reference - the surfaced element is a character portrait + product name only).
findings.required_fix: None - the mechanism distinction is adequate and the two owner rejections are not touched. Keep the differs_from_past_attempt note in the changelog entry so the distinction is on record.

findings.issue: The plan describes the asset as a 'premium 120px portrait,' but the source file is a busy 1920x1080 celebratory scene (balloons/confetti, a 'For You!' hearts placard); confirm it clears the owner's premium/not-childish bar at build time.
findings.evidence: Read images/potato-buyer.jpg: it is a wide, confetti-and-balloons scene of the crocheted potato holding a red-hearts 'For You!' card. Mitigant checked in code: .product-image is width/height 120px, border-radius:50%, object-fit:cover with a gold border (claim.html:181-192) - the circular center-crop keeps the smiling character + placard and crops out most balloons/confetti, so it renders as an on-brand gold-ringed portrait, not the full busy scene. Design bar (FUNNEL_CONTEXT.md:227-229, a HARD constraint) is 'premium and refined, not childish'; the how_to_verify already renders mobile before/after PNGs and checks for clutter, and the change is reversible via re-adding display:none.
findings.required_fix: None required to approve; at build, render the mobile PNGs for PTT-GREEN1/CPCK1 as planned and eyeball that the circular crop reads premium (not childish clutter). If it reads busy, adjust object-position rather than abandoning the change.
